{"action":"add","items":["Check the conversation for an already-running matching Shell task.","Start one background Shell loop with `is_background: true` and `output_notification` set to `^AGENT_LOOP_TICK_<purpose>`.","Use a unique sentinel and a regex such as `^AGENT_LOOP_TICK_<purpose>`.","Check that Shell returns a `task_id` and reports the task as running.","Run the prompt once immediately after arming the loop.","The first sentinel should arrive only after the initial sleep, so startup does not double-run the prompt.","Track the `task_id` so the agent can stop the loop if asked, using `Task({ resume: task_id, interrupt: true })`.","Briefly confirm the interval, that the prompt already ran once, when the first tick will arrive, and that the loop will fire on each tick until stopped.","Parse `1m echo tick` as a fixed 60-second schedule with the prompt `echo tick`."]}
